pages.text: Every Akaishi trinket runs on the same shared machinery:$(li)each effect drains its own internal energy buffer first$(li)when the buffer runs dry, the trinket sips power from the $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cells$(/l) in your inventory$(li)carry one cell and the whole set stays alive on the go$(br2)They split into three roles, each with its own entry: $(l:akaishi:curios_income)Fortune Trinkets$(/l) drop crystals, $(l:akaishi:curios_defense)Defense Trinkets$(/l) shrug off damage, $(l:akaishi:curios_survival)Sustain Trinkets$(/l) feed you and cure debuffs.

$(bold)Slot map (Curios):$(0)$(li)rings -> ring$(li)bracelets -> hands$(li)pendants -> necklace$(li)charms -> charm$(li)chest trinkets -> body$(li)bangles -> bracelet$(li)waist trinkets -> belt$(br2)Wrong slot? It won't equip. Check which slots you have unlocked before you wear anything.

The three group entries: $(l:akaishi:curios_income)Fortune$(/l) / $(l:akaishi:curios_defense)Defense$(/l) / $(l:akaishi:curios_survival)Sustain$(/l); the battery that keeps them going is the $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cell$(/l).
